content.text: Rulership is a focus on Stewardship.
Every Rulership event will trigger this event. CHECK : All following events below have 85% chance to happen independently of each other:

items.text: Stewardship Education Level Up (if not max level), gain lawgiver nickname when reaching Midas Touched
Administrator Level Up :

children.text: Great Raja Dharma modifier (+2 Stewardship) if Jain and Administrator

items.text: More Just lose arbitrary or gain just with a nickname if not having one
More Diligent lose slothful or gain diligent
More Ambitious lose content or gain ambitious
Legendary Wisdom modifier (+1 Prestige) requires administrator and 12 or more Stewardship, unlock Wise Guy achievement
Respected Ruler modifier (+10 vassal opinion) requires administrator and 8 or more Stewardship

content.text: A peasant is dragged before court, ruler must decide what to do with him. Possibility of a follow-up event.

items.text: Hanged 50% chance of losing 20 Prestige gaining the Rash nickname (the hanged was not the murderer)
Imprisoned either Another Murder (Peasant imprisoned) lose 20 Prestige or Another Murder (Peasant died in dungeon) lose 20 Prestige
Peasant set free 50% chance of losing 20 Prestige (another murder)
Tortured peasant equal chance of either:

children.text: Peasant admits under torture 50% chance of Another Murder (Peasant died during torture) lose 20 Prestige
Peasant does not admit under torture 50% chance of Another Murder (Peasant died during torture) lose 20 Prestige

content.text: 2 random vassals are chosen for the feud. Must side with one of them Angry (-15) and Happy (+15) opinion modifiers for 2 years. Or Upset (-5 opinion) both for 2 years. Gain Rulership Level Up .
Requires a vassal that is not incapable, not a close relative and not a spouse. All choices grant Rulership Level Up the next day.

items.text: Vassal loses 50 Wealth and 15 opinion ( Angry ) for 2 years.
Province gains Peasant Unrest (+10% local revolt risk, -50% local tax modifier) modifier for 1 year, vassal gains 15 opinion ( Happy ) for 2 years.
Lose 50 wealth, vassal gains 15 opinion ( Happy ) for 2 years.

content.text: Creates a suspected witch courtier among 2 non-random templates. All choices grant Rulership Level Up the next day.

items.text: amateurish plotter , hunchback , wroth , envious , paranoid , deceitful , shy and cynical with random base attributes.
naive appeaser , ugly , kind , charitable , humble , honest , shy and trusting with random base attributes..

content.text: Ruler then chooses what to do with suspected witch.

items.text: Burn at the stake province gain Subjects Are Feeling Protected (-5% local revolt risk) modifier for 1 year, gain 30 Piety
Imprison suspected witch
Release witch province gain Peasant Unrest (+10% local revolt risk, -50% local tax modifier) modifier for 1 year, gain 50 culture techpoints.

content.text: Requires a drunkard vassal that is not incapable, not a close relative and not a spouse. A random demesne province is chosen as the drunken rampage location. All choices grant Rulership Level Up the next day.

items.text: Gain 30 Prestige, lose 50 Wealth, vassal loses 15 opinion ( Angry ) for 2 years.
Lose 30 Prestige, province gain Merchants Unhappy (-20% city tax) modifier for 1 year, vassal gains 15 opinion ( Happy ) for 2 years.
Lose 50 Wealth, vassal gains 15 opinion ( Happy ) for 2 years.

content.text: Event chooses a brigand Noble and a brigand Mayor. All choices grant Rulership Level Up the next day.

items.text: Noble is happy and gains 50 wealth, Mayor is unhappy and loses 50 Wealth, both for 2 years.
Noble is unhappy, Mayor is happy, both for 2 years.
Spend 50 Wealth, both are happy for 2 years.
